_comment: Shipped defaults. A household adds C:\ProgramData\WinTV\apps.json: any top-level key there replaces the one here, and addApps (with "after": id) / removeApps edit the app list. kind: web = browser app window with its own profile; browser = full browser; exe = program; uri = protocol link; settings = WinTV Settings; allapps = All apps; power = power menu. drm: true turns on Widevine in that tile's Brave profile. logo: a file name on Wikimedia Commons, downloaded by the TV (logoStyle wordmark = the logo replaces the name; logoWhite = drawn white). lockScreen: minutes idle on the home screen before the clock screen (0 = never), and minutes after which waking asks who is watching. homeKeys / quickKeys: keyboard shortcuts for Home and quick settings (the remote's Home key, held or tapped, works through input.ps1). keyboard: autoOpen = the on-screen keyboard comes up when a text field gets the focus in any app; layout = auto | qwerty | qwertz. wallpapers: the live wallpapers, open-licensed videos on Wikimedia Commons by file name, with a short title (the TV downloads them, only 60 fps or more; author and licence come from Commons).
